main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Gnosis allows us to free ourselves from matter
header_desc: Texts written almost two thousand years ago hold the solution to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. In this context, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states —the spiritual state |UNO⟩ ❤️ and the material state |EGO⟩ 🧠— granting us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨UNO❤️ | EGO🧠⟩, thus revealing that we harbor the divine spark within ourselves.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From Yaldabaoth's Prison to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. Similarly, the demiurgic ego exerts its own gravity: its density warps your inner fabric and weaves the materio-temporal illusion of the psyche. Therefore, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to transcend that curvature and return to the divine and timeless realm of the cosmos, in the purity of the pneuma. In this light, the phrase 'the Father and I are one' is a call to dissolve the 'false self' to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension |999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension |666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: A Journey through Gnosis and Physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity vs. Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breaking of simultaneity by Einstein, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin-Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as imprisonment of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethinking (1984) as a cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial system of slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the grand paradox boils down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is there where Jesus' phrase, 'The Father and I are one,' resonates most strongly. Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, bigger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting each sparrow's fall, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is little sense in praying to the law of gravity.
